messages:
Add createPatch(from, to) for computing a JSON Patch diff (RFC 6902)

Lets clients send only what changed between two document versions
instead of the whole new one. Builds on the existing deepEqual/
deepClone/isObject helpers: objects diff member by member, arrays diff
index by index with trailing add/remove, and anything else (a type
change, or two differing scalars) becomes a single "replace".
